name: slack-shell-bridge
description: Small bridge service that lets the static Slack Shell app read and write a real Slack workspace. Holds the Slack tokens, connects to Slack via Socket Mode and fans events out to browsers over WebSocket.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/slack.js && node --check src/events.js && node --check src/tokens.js && node --check src/config.js
